name: Virtual Ties ~Isekaijoucho Musoukyoku~
original_name: Virtual Ties ～ヰ世界情緒夢想曲～
source:
Returning from Tokyo to the island where he once lived, Kirishima Yuu reunites with his childhood friend Minase Sekai.

Sekai, who had once dreamed of becoming an idol, now seems to have lost her sparkle and is on the verge of giving up on that dream.

Wanting to see her smile again, Yuu makes a proposal: make Sekai debut as a virtual idol using  illustration he drew himself.

Both Sekai and Yuu are new to virtual activities, but together they managed to debut as virtual idol named "Isekaijoucho".
Feeling encouraged by their first livestream, the pair set out with the goals of reaching 100,000 subscribers and holding a real-life concert.
translation:
雾岛悠从东京回到曾经居住的岛屿，与儿时好友水濑世界重逢。

曾经梦想成为偶像的世界，现在似乎已经失去了光芒，濒临放弃梦想的边缘。

为了再次看到她的笑容，优提出了一个建议：用他自己画的插图让世界作为虚拟偶像出道。

Sekai和Yuu都是虚拟活动的新手，但他们一起以虚拟偶像“异世界城町”的身份首次亮相。
受到第一次直播的鼓舞，两人的目标是吸引100,000名订阅者并举办一场现实生活中的音乐会。
